page.notes: The page is cut off at the right; the right column is partly cut. Several right-column lines are cut short at the edge and some lines in the left column are uncertain. Left margin shows only cut-off fragments of an earlier column; the page is torn and stained at the left edge. Headword lines with a leading "Helmene." etc. are index entries. Some letters at the left edge (for example "s" forms in "Hei-" and "Herl-") are doubtful. The line "LIL 4 Hettilo" is taken as a catchword and signature-like mark and may be a corrupt catchword.
